data.title: XtalPi Advances Hair Loss Drug Program into IND-Enabling Studies
data.description: A specialized program is aimed at reactivating dormant hair follicle stem cells by focusing on the lactate-autophagy pathway. In trials using mice, a specific candidate produced a hair growth result similar to that of 5% topical minoxidil but at only 1/100th of the concentration of the comparator. This significant achievement is a step forward in the research and development of new methods for promoting hair growth.
